title: Winter Storm Safety: During a Winter Storm (if your car gets stuck)
licence_note: US federal government work (NOAA/NWS). Read 2026-11-16 by R7: stay in the vehicle; run the motor about 10 minutes each hour; open a window a little; clear the exhaust pipe; dome light at night when running the engine; bright cloth on the antenna or door.

title: Stop the Bleed: just-in-time instructions (apply pressure, apply a tourniquet)
org: National Center for Disaster Medicine and Public Health, Uniformed Services University (USUHS)
licence_note: US federal government work (Uniformed Services University, DoD). Read 2026-11-16 by R7: place the tourniquet 2-3 inches above the wound, between the torso and the wound; twist until bleeding stops; a second tourniquet above the first if it still bleeds; do not loosen or remove the tourniquet.

title: Treatment of Low Blood Sugar (Hypoglycemia)
licence_note: US federal government work. Read 2026-11-16 by R7: the 15-15 rule (15 grams of carbohydrate, wait 15 minutes, recheck, repeat until in range, then a snack or meal); glucagon for severe lows, then emergency care.

title: CPSC Warns of Dangers After a Hurricane or Power Outage Hits (news release, 2006)
licence_note: US federal government work.
